responsibility: This module implements the gccrs parsing subsystem that turns Rust token streams into AST structures and parser-side metadata. Its core is the templated recursive-descent/Pratt parser declared in `rust-parse.h` and implemented in `rust-parse-impl.h`, which covers major Rust grammar categories including crates, items, statements, expressions, patterns, types, attributes, token trees, and macro-related syntax while tracking ambiguities, restrictions, and parser diagnostics. Companion instantiation files bind that generic parser to the front end’s different token sources for normal source lexing, macro invocation parsing, and procedural macro parsing, so the same grammar machinery can be reused across ordinary and macro-expansion contexts. The module also includes shared non-template parsing support for inline/external module `#[path]` resolution and for validating `macro_rules!` matcher follow-set constraints, plus a small dedicated parser for `-frust-cfg` option syntax used by conditional compilation handling. Overall, this directory is responsible for Rust surface-syntax recognition and parser-specific semantic checks before later name resolution, expansion, and lowering stages.
